title: Video Archive
desc:
60 Years of Memories. 60 Years of Inspiration. 💙💛

As we celebrate 60 glorious years of Woodlands House School, Srinagar, we are delighted to share the journey of one of our proud alumni, Dr. Raies Khan, Batch of 1994.

From the classrooms of WHS to a career spanning over two decades in healthcare, Dr. Raies Khan’s journey has taken him across India and into international and overseas healthcare initiatives, with organisations including GVK EMRI, Shalby Hospitals, ASG Hospitals, and Paras Health, among others.

Reflecting on his journey, Dr. Raies shares how WHS gave him more than an education—it gave him a strong foundation of values, friendships, confidence, and memories that have remained with him throughout the years.

From Kashmir to different parts of India and beyond, every chapter of his professional journey has been shaped by the experiences and values he carries with him from his school years.

Proud to be a Woodlandite, Dr. Raies remains grateful to the school that helped shape the person and professional he is today.

As we celebrate six remarkable decades of learning, friendships, growth, and cherished memories, stories like his remind us of the lasting impact of Woodlands House School and the remarkable journeys of its alumni.

Here’s to 60 years of WHS, 60 years of memories, and 60 years of inspiring generations.

Happy 60th Anniversary, Woodlands House School, Srinagar! 💙💛

#60YearsOfWoodlands #WoodlandsHouseSchool #WoodlandsSrinagar #WHS60 #60YearsOfInspiringMinds

title: Video Archive
desc:
✨ Waheguru Ji Ka Khalsa, Waheguru Ji Ki Fateh! ✨

​Happy Vaisakhi from all of us at Woodlands House School, Srinagar! 🌾💛

​In this beautiful presentation, our 7th-grade students take us through the deep cultural and historical significance of Vaisakhi. They beautifully highlight how this auspicious day is not only a celebration of the bountiful harvest season—filled with gratitude, traditional music, and joyful dances—but also a deeply spiritual occasion marking the establishment of the Khalsa Panth by Guru Gobind Singh Ji in 1699 at Anandpur Sahib.

​As our students remind us, Vaisakhi is a timeless celebration of mutual love, universal brotherhood, and our rich, vibrant heritage. We are incredibly proud of our students for keeping these beautiful traditions alive!

​#Vaisakhi #WoodlandsHouseSchool #WHSSrinagar #Baisakhi #CulturalHeritage

title: Post Archive
desc:
57th Foundation day marked with grand celebrations at Woodlands House School, Srinagar

Pride of our institution is its legacy, and we will continue the pursuit of excellence in education, says Viraj Singh, Director of Woodland

Arsalan Ashiq / Anas Riyaz 

Srinagar, Sep 9 (KB): Woodlands House School Srinagar, a beacon of education located in the heart of Srinagar, celebrated its 57th foundation day with great fervor and enthusiasm. The event was marked by a series of vibrant performances and special guests.

According to the Kashmir Bulletin (KB), the school ground came alive with the melodious notes of a welcome song performed by the students, setting the tone for the festivities. The young talents then took to the stage in a dazzling fashion show, showcasing their creativity and style.

“The audience was treated to an array of designs and outfits, reflecting the diverse talents within the student body. A musical item added an extra dimension to the celebration, with students displaying their musical prowess and captivating the audience with their harmonious melodies.”

The highlight of the event was the presence of the esteemed Chief Guest, President of the National Conference, who graced the occasion with his presence and delivered an inspiring speech emphasizing the importance of education and nurturing young talents.

Speaking on the occasion, the Director of Woodland House School, Srinagar, Viraj Singh, told KB about his pride in the institution's legacy and its continuous pursuit of excellence in education.

“He announced an exciting development for the school, stating, ‘Woodlands House School is poised to make history in the valley by introducing the first-ever Pickleball turf. This cutting-edge facility will be inaugurated in the coming week, opening up new avenues for sports and recreation.’

Likewise, the announcement of the Pickleball turf generated excitement among students, faculty, and parents alike, as it promises to provide a state-of-the-art sports facility for the school community. (KB)

title: Post Archive
desc:
Woodlands House School was established by our beloved Founder Principal Mrs Rup SP Singh in the year 1966 under the foothills of the world famous Takht-e-Sulaiman/Shankaracharya Temple. Initially the school started with a few students but her dedication, devotion and hard work attracted the people of J&K in general and that of Srinagar in particular. The institution began to progress and within no time the curve of the roll started going up. Her work was recognized by the then Chief Minister, Late Bakshi Gulam Mohammad and later on by Sheikh Mohammed Abdullah who encouraged her to start her junior wing at Shivpora, Srinagar which later was converted to the Girls Wing. Woodlands House School was the need of the hour as only a few English Medium Schools were functioning and a good number of students got enrolled in the school. Under her dynamic leadership our school moved forward in every sphere- academic, co-curricular and infrastructural. She was full of keen insight and a balance of best qualities of head and heart. We are really proud of her leadership and guidance. Her role as a competent head of the prestigious institution is recognized equally by students and noble citizens of the state. 

She had adream of an ideal institution which serves as a corrective measure for students and an ameliorative factor for the society which she truly achieved during her tenure. She wished that students should be able to imbibe best social and moral values during their education in the school and after completion of their education they would serve as role models in the society. The result of which is that our students excel in different fields and bring laurels of success to the institution. Unfortunately our Founder Principal parted with us in the year 1995 and her son, Mr. Riki Singh, the Chairman/Principal of the school had to shoulder the responsibility of running and managing the school as per the expectations of the people. Following the footprints of our founder he leaves no stone unturned to make this institution a success.

desc:
60 Years of Woodlands. 60 Years of Shaping Futures. ❤️

As we celebrate 60 remarkable years of Woodlands House School, Srinagar, we are proud to hear from our alumni whose journeys continue to be a part of the Woodlands story.

In this special message, Chandandeep Singh Rana, WHS Batch 2005, Class X, shares his heartfelt congratulations on six decades of educational excellence and reflects on the role Woodlands played in shaping his career.

Today, Chandandeep serves as the Operations Head at UM Orthotics, carrying forward a journey that began with the foundation, guidance, and values nurtured at WHS.

He expresses his gratitude to the teachers and management for inspiring students, shaping their careers, and continuing to uphold the quality of education that has defined Woodlands through the years.

What makes this milestone even more meaningful is seeing the generations of Woodlanders who have gone on to make their mark in different fields and contribute to society.

60 years of education.
60 years of inspiration.
60 years of shaping careers and creating dynamic personalities. ❤️

We are proud of our alumni and grateful for the memories, values, and journeys that continue to strengthen the Woodlands legacy.

Here’s to 60 glorious years of WHS and many more years of excellence and success ahead!

For six decades, Woodlands House School, Srinagar has been more than a place of learning. It has been a place where curiosity is encouraged, character is shaped, talent is nurtured, and dreams take flight.

From the classroom to the playing field, from the laboratory to the chessboard, Woodlands has always believed that true education is about developing minds that think, hearts that care, and individuals who lead.

title: Story Archive
desc:
60 Years of Memories. 60 Years of Inspiration. 💙💛

As we celebrate 60 glorious years of Woodlands House School, Srinagar, we are delighted to share the journey of one of our proud alumni, Dr. Raies Khan, Batch of 1994.

From the classrooms of WHS to a career spanning over two decades in healthcare, Dr. Raies Khan’s journey has taken him across India and into international and overseas healthcare initiatives, with organisations including GVK EMRI, Shalby Hospitals, ASG Hospitals, and Paras Health, among others.

Reflecting on his journey, Dr. Raies shares how WHS gave him more than an education—it gave him a strong foundation of values, friendships, confidence, and memories that have remained with him throughout the years.

From Kashmir to different parts of India and beyond, every chapter of his professional journey has been shaped by the experiences and values he carries with him from his school years.

Proud to be a Woodlandite, Dr. Raies remains grateful to the school that helped shape the person and professional he is today.

As we celebrate six remarkable decades of learning, friendships, growth, and cherished memories, stories like his remind us of the lasting impact of Woodlands House School and the remarkable journeys of its alumni.

Here’s to 60 years of WHS, 60 years of memories, and 60 years of inspiring generations.

Happy 60th Anniversary, Woodlands House School, Srinagar! 💙💛

title: Story Archive
desc:
✨ Waheguru Ji Ka Khalsa, Waheguru Ji Ki Fateh! ✨

​Happy Vaisakhi from all of us at Woodlands House School, Srinagar! 🌾💛

​In this beautiful presentation, our 7th-grade students take us through the deep cultural and historical significance of Vaisakhi. They beautifully highlight how this auspicious day is not only a celebration of the bountiful harvest season—filled with gratitude, traditional music, and joyful dances—but also a deeply spiritual occasion marking the establishment of the Khalsa Panth by Guru Gobind Singh Ji in 1699 at Anandpur Sahib.

​As our students remind us, Vaisakhi is a timeless celebration of mutual love, universal brotherhood, and our rich, vibrant heritage. We are incredibly proud of our students for keeping these beautiful traditions alive!

​#Vaisakhi #WoodlandsHouseSchool #WHSSrinagar #Baisakhi #CulturalHeritage

​Happy Vaisakhi from all of us at Woodlands House School, Srinagar! 🌾💛

​In this beautiful presentation, our 7th-grade students take us through the deep cultural and historical significance of Vaisakhi. They beautifully highlight how this auspicious day is not only a celebration of the bountiful harvest season—filled with gratitude, traditional music, and joyful dances—but also a deeply spiritual occasion marking the establishment of the Khalsa Panth by Guru Gobind Singh Ji in 1699 at Anandpur Sahib.

​As our students remind us, Vaisakhi is a timeless celebration of mutual love, universal brotherhood, and our rich, vibrant heritage. We are incredibly proud of our students for keeping these beautiful traditions alive!

title: Post Archive
desc:
57th Foundation day marked with grand celebrations at Woodlands House School, Srinagar

Pride of our institution is its legacy, and we will continue the pursuit of excellence in education, says Viraj Singh, Director of Woodland

Arsalan Ashiq / Anas Riyaz 

Srinagar, Sep 9 (KB): Woodlands House School Srinagar, a beacon of education located in the heart of Srinagar, celebrated its 57th foundation day with great fervor and enthusiasm. The event was marked by a series of vibrant performances and special guests.

According to the Kashmir Bulletin (KB), the school ground came alive with the melodious notes of a welcome song performed by the students, setting the tone for the festivities. The young talents then took to the stage in a dazzling fashion show, showcasing their creativity and style.

“The audience was treated to an array of designs and outfits, reflecting the diverse talents within the student body. A musical item added an extra dimension to the celebration, with students displaying their musical prowess and captivating the audience with their harmonious melodies.”

The highlight of the event was the presence of the esteemed Chief Guest, President of the National Conference, who graced the occasion with his presence and delivered an inspiring speech emphasizing the importance of education and nurturing young talents.

Speaking on the occasion, the Director of Woodland House School, Srinagar, Viraj Singh, told KB about his pride in the institution's legacy and its continuous pursuit of excellence in education.

“He announced an exciting development for the school, stating, ‘Woodlands House School is poised to make history in the valley by introducing the first-ever Pickleball turf. This cutting-edge facility will be inaugurated in the coming week, opening up new avenues for sports and recreation.’

Likewise, the announcement of the Pickleball turf generated excitement among students, faculty, and parents alike, as it promises to provide a state-of-the-art sports facility for the school community. (KB)

title: Story Archive
desc:
60 Years of Woodlands. 60 Years of Shaping Futures. ❤️

As we celebrate 60 remarkable years of Woodlands House School, Srinagar, we are proud to hear from our alumni whose journeys continue to be a part of the Woodlands story.

In this special message, Chandandeep Singh Rana, WHS Batch 2005, Class X, shares his heartfelt congratulations on six decades of educational excellence and reflects on the role Woodlands played in shaping his career.

Today, Chandandeep serves as the Operations Head at UM Orthotics, carrying forward a journey that began with the foundation, guidance, and values nurtured at WHS.

He expresses his gratitude to the teachers and management for inspiring students, shaping their careers, and continuing to uphold the quality of education that has defined Woodlands through the years.

What makes this milestone even more meaningful is seeing the generations of Woodlanders who have gone on to make their mark in different fields and contribute to society.

60 years of education.
60 years of inspiration.
60 years of shaping careers and creating dynamic personalities. ❤️

We are proud of our alumni and grateful for the memories, values, and journeys that continue to strengthen the Woodlands legacy.

Here’s to 60 glorious years of WHS and many more years of excellence and success ahead!

​Happy Vaisakhi from all of us at Woodlands House School, Srinagar! 🌾💛

​In this beautiful presentation, our 7th-grade students take us through the deep cultural and historical significance of Vaisakhi. They beautifully highlight how this auspicious day is not only a celebration of the bountiful harvest season—filled with gratitude, traditional music, and joyful dances—but also a deeply spiritual occasion marking the establishment of the Khalsa Panth by Guru Gobind Singh Ji in 1699 at Anandpur Sahib.

​As our students remind us, Vaisakhi is a timeless celebration of mutual love, universal brotherhood, and our rich, vibrant heritage. We are incredibly proud of our students for keeping these beautiful traditions alive!

As we celebrate 60 glorious years of Woodlands House School, Srinagar, we are delighted to share the journey of one of our proud alumni, Dr. Raies Khan, Batch of 1994.

From the classrooms of WHS to a career spanning over two decades in healthcare, Dr. Raies Khan’s journey has taken him across India and into international and overseas healthcare initiatives, with organisations including GVK EMRI, Shalby Hospitals, ASG Hospitals, and Paras Health, among others.

Reflecting on his journey, Dr. Raies shares how WHS gave him more than an education—it gave him a strong foundation of values, friendships, confidence, and memories that have remained with him throughout the years.

From Kashmir to different parts of India and beyond, every chapter of his professional journey has been shaped by the experiences and values he carries with him from his school years.

Proud to be a Woodlandite, Dr. Raies remains grateful to the school that helped shape the person and professional he is today.

As we celebrate six remarkable decades of learning, friendships, growth, and cherished memories, stories like his remind us of the lasting impact of Woodlands House School and the remarkable journeys of its alumni.

Here’s to 60 years of WHS, 60 years of memories, and 60 years of inspiring generations.

Happy 60th Anniversary, Woodlands House School, Srinagar! 💙💛

title: Video Archive
desc:
✨ Waheguru Ji Ka Khalsa, Waheguru Ji Ki Fateh! ✨

​Happy Vaisakhi from all of us at Woodlands House School, Srinagar! 🌾💛

​In this beautiful presentation, our 7th-grade students take us through the deep cultural and historical significance of Vaisakhi. They beautifully highlight how this auspicious day is not only a celebration of the bountiful harvest season—filled with gratitude, traditional music, and joyful dances—but also a deeply spiritual occasion marking the establishment of the Khalsa Panth by Guru Gobind Singh Ji in 1699 at Anandpur Sahib.

​As our students remind us, Vaisakhi is a timeless celebration of mutual love, universal brotherhood, and our rich, vibrant heritage. We are incredibly proud of our students for keeping these beautiful traditions alive!

title: Post Archive
desc:
57th Foundation day marked with grand celebrations at Woodlands House School, Srinagar

Pride of our institution is its legacy, and we will continue the pursuit of excellence in education, says Viraj Singh, Director of Woodland

Arsalan Ashiq / Anas Riyaz 

Srinagar, Sep 9 (KB): Woodlands House School Srinagar, a beacon of education located in the heart of Srinagar, celebrated its 57th foundation day with great fervor and enthusiasm. The event was marked by a series of vibrant performances and special guests.

According to the Kashmir Bulletin (KB), the school ground came alive with the melodious notes of a welcome song performed by the students, setting the tone for the festivities. The young talents then took to the stage in a dazzling fashion show, showcasing their creativity and style.

“The audience was treated to an array of designs and outfits, reflecting the diverse talents within the student body. A musical item added an extra dimension to the celebration, with students displaying their musical prowess and captivating the audience with their harmonious melodies.”

The highlight of the event was the presence of the esteemed Chief Guest, President of the National Conference, who graced the occasion with his presence and delivered an inspiring speech emphasizing the importance of education and nurturing young talents.

Speaking on the occasion, the Director of Woodland House School, Srinagar, Viraj Singh, told KB about his pride in the institution's legacy and its continuous pursuit of excellence in education.

“He announced an exciting development for the school, stating, ‘Woodlands House School is poised to make history in the valley by introducing the first-ever Pickleball turf. This cutting-edge facility will be inaugurated in the coming week, opening up new avenues for sports and recreation.’

Likewise, the announcement of the Pickleball turf generated excitement among students, faculty, and parents alike, as it promises to provide a state-of-the-art sports facility for the school community. (KB)

title: Post Archive
desc:
Woodlands House School was established by our beloved Founder Principal Mrs Rup SP Singh in the year 1966 under the foothills of the world famous Takht-e-Sulaiman/Shankaracharya Temple. Initially the school started with a few students but her dedication, devotion and hard work attracted the people of J&K in general and that of Srinagar in particular. The institution began to progress and within no time the curve of the roll started going up. Her work was recognized by the then Chief Minister, Late Bakshi Gulam Mohammad and later on by Sheikh Mohammed Abdullah who encouraged her to start her junior wing at Shivpora, Srinagar which later was converted to the Girls Wing. Woodlands House School was the need of the hour as only a few English Medium Schools were functioning and a good number of students got enrolled in the school. Under her dynamic leadership our school moved forward in every sphere- academic, co-curricular and infrastructural. She was full of keen insight and a balance of best qualities of head and heart. We are really proud of her leadership and guidance. Her role as a competent head of the prestigious institution is recognized equally by students and noble citizens of the state. 

She had adream of an ideal institution which serves as a corrective measure for students and an ameliorative factor for the society which she truly achieved during her tenure. She wished that students should be able to imbibe best social and moral values during their education in the school and after completion of their education they would serve as role models in the society. The result of which is that our students excel in different fields and bring laurels of success to the institution. Unfortunately our Founder Principal parted with us in the year 1995 and her son, Mr. Riki Singh, the Chairman/Principal of the school had to shoulder the responsibility of running and managing the school as per the expectations of the people. Following the footprints of our founder he leaves no stone unturned to make this institution a success.

​Happy Vaisakhi from all of us at Woodlands House School, Srinagar! 🌾💛

​In this beautiful presentation, our 7th-grade students take us through the deep cultural and historical significance of Vaisakhi. They beautifully highlight how this auspicious day is not only a celebration of the bountiful harvest season—filled with gratitude, traditional music, and joyful dances—but also a deeply spiritual occasion marking the establishment of the Khalsa Panth by Guru Gobind Singh Ji in 1699 at Anandpur Sahib.

​As our students remind us, Vaisakhi is a timeless celebration of mutual love, universal brotherhood, and our rich, vibrant heritage. We are incredibly proud of our students for keeping these beautiful traditions alive!

title: Post Archive
desc:
57th Foundation day marked with grand celebrations at Woodlands House School, Srinagar

Pride of our institution is its legacy, and we will continue the pursuit of excellence in education, says Viraj Singh, Director of Woodland

Arsalan Ashiq / Anas Riyaz 

Srinagar, Sep 9 (KB): Woodlands House School Srinagar, a beacon of education located in the heart of Srinagar, celebrated its 57th foundation day with great fervor and enthusiasm. The event was marked by a series of vibrant performances and special guests.

According to the Kashmir Bulletin (KB), the school ground came alive with the melodious notes of a welcome song performed by the students, setting the tone for the festivities. The young talents then took to the stage in a dazzling fashion show, showcasing their creativity and style.

“The audience was treated to an array of designs and outfits, reflecting the diverse talents within the student body. A musical item added an extra dimension to the celebration, with students displaying their musical prowess and captivating the audience with their harmonious melodies.”

The highlight of the event was the presence of the esteemed Chief Guest, President of the National Conference, who graced the occasion with his presence and delivered an inspiring speech emphasizing the importance of education and nurturing young talents.

Speaking on the occasion, the Director of Woodland House School, Srinagar, Viraj Singh, told KB about his pride in the institution's legacy and its continuous pursuit of excellence in education.

“He announced an exciting development for the school, stating, ‘Woodlands House School is poised to make history in the valley by introducing the first-ever Pickleball turf. This cutting-edge facility will be inaugurated in the coming week, opening up new avenues for sports and recreation.’

Likewise, the announcement of the Pickleball turf generated excitement among students, faculty, and parents alike, as it promises to provide a state-of-the-art sports facility for the school community. (KB)

title: Post Archive
desc:
Woodlands House School was established by our beloved Founder Principal Mrs Rup SP Singh in the year 1966 under the foothills of the world famous Takht-e-Sulaiman/Shankaracharya Temple. Initially the school started with a few students but her dedication, devotion and hard work attracted the people of J&K in general and that of Srinagar in particular. The institution began to progress and within no time the curve of the roll started going up. Her work was recognized by the then Chief Minister, Late Bakshi Gulam Mohammad and later on by Sheikh Mohammed Abdullah who encouraged her to start her junior wing at Shivpora, Srinagar which later was converted to the Girls Wing. Woodlands House School was the need of the hour as only a few English Medium Schools were functioning and a good number of students got enrolled in the school. Under her dynamic leadership our school moved forward in every sphere- academic, co-curricular and infrastructural. She was full of keen insight and a balance of best qualities of head and heart. We are really proud of her leadership and guidance. Her role as a competent head of the prestigious institution is recognized equally by students and noble citizens of the state. 

She had adream of an ideal institution which serves as a corrective measure for students and an ameliorative factor for the society which she truly achieved during her tenure. She wished that students should be able to imbibe best social and moral values during their education in the school and after completion of their education they would serve as role models in the society. The result of which is that our students excel in different fields and bring laurels of success to the institution. Unfortunately our Founder Principal parted with us in the year 1995 and her son, Mr. Riki Singh, the Chairman/Principal of the school had to shoulder the responsibility of running and managing the school as per the expectations of the people. Following the footprints of our founder he leaves no stone unturned to make this institution a success.
